newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY LEAGUE- Blake forced out of Warriors lineup.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE- Blake forced out of Warriors lineup.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Feb 28 - Injury has forced utility Phil Blake to withdraw from the Auckland Warriors Super League opener against the Brisbane Broncos in Brisbane on Saturday night, NZPA reports.
Blake, himself a replacement for injured winger Lee Oudenryn, has been ruled out with a groin strain.
His place on the left wing will be taken by Anthony Swann.
Disruption to their travel plans has forced the Warriors to charter their own flight and the team will not arrive in Brisbane until 11.00 p.m. (local time) tonight.
